title: UPDATE: OpenAI Executes Global Codex Reset Following Community Vote
summary:
Tibo Sottiaux, the Codex lead at OpenAI, processed a system-wide wipe for developer tools on Oct 7 after users voted against a set of proposed improvements. The move occurred even though the company had shipped four product updates and several math proofs earlier that day, according to Sottiaux. This reset is part of a 28 day daily shipping cycle where the company provides either a functional update or a full system reset for Codex and other work products based on community input.

The sprint began on Oct 4 and initially delivered a 50% speed optimization for GPT-6 Astra and GPT-6.1 Sol, raising throughput from 30 to 50 tokens per second. These improvements apply to all subscribers and partners using 'Sign in with ChatGPT,' including Devin, OpenCode, Pi, and Amp. OpenAI is prioritizing efficiency and simplification for its coder base following recent updates shared at DevDay.
